description: Mediation Board Commission - Notice calling for Nominations for the Appointment of Mediators
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the appointment of mediators to Mediation Boards, which falls under judicial/law enforcement matters. It involves calling for nominations for judicial dispute resolution positions (Chairman and Mediators of Mediation Boards), specifying eligibility criteria, and outlining the appointment process under the Mediation Boards Act. This aligns with Type 9 (Judicial/Law Enforcement) as it deals with judicial appointments and the administration of alternative dispute resolution mechanisms within the legal system.
